payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model compared to state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in macro-average F1-scores for various discourse relations.

claims.text: The model improves the macro-average F1-score for implicit discourse relations by 2% compared to previous neural tensor network models.
The model achieves a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, outperforming the best previous system by 1%.
The ensemble model achieves a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit discourse relations compared to the single model.
